section5.text: A proper first visit, not a five-minute look. You leave knowing what is going on, what needs doing, what can wait, and what it would cost.

section-navy6.story-caption: 6695 WADSWORTH BLVD · PARKING AT THE DOOR
section-navy6.h2: One practice for everyone at your address.
section-navy6.text: 6695 Wadsworth Blvd, Arvada, CO 80003, open Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm. Children and adults are both treated here, and the practice covers general and family dentistry right through to implants, veneers and full-mouth reconstruction.
section7.h2: Close by, and equipped for the whole job.
section7.benefit-text: On Wadsworth with parking at the door, so a check-up does not cost you half a day.
section7.benefit-text2: The practice treats children and adults, so the whole household can be seen by the same team.
section7.benefit-text3: Dr. Bennett is board certified to administer IV sedation and does so himself, for anyone the dentist frightens.
section7.benefit-text4: Implants, veneers and full-mouth reconstruction happen in the same building, with an in-house lab.

section9.h2: Know what comes next before you book.
section9.journey-text: Request the special online or call. The office confirms the appointment and answers anything you want to ask first.
section9.journey-text2: A comprehensive exam and digital X-rays, plus an OralID oral cancer screening, so nothing is being guessed at.
section9.journey-text3: One of the doctors talks you through what is going on, what needs doing, and what can safely wait.
section9.h34: Book the rest of the household
section9.journey-text4: Appointments for the family can be arranged around the same trip. Payment plans and financing are available.

section13.faq-answer: 6695 Wadsworth Blvd, Arvada, CO 80003, on Wadsworth with parking at the door. Open Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm.
section13.faq-answer2: A comprehensive exam, digital X-rays, an OralID oral cancer screening and a personalised treatment plan. New patients aged 18 and over; restrictions apply.
section13.faq-toggle3: Can you see my kids too?
section13.faq-answer3: Yes. The practice treats both children and adults. Note the $109 special itself applies to patients 18 and older.
section13.faq-toggle4: What if I need something more involved than a cleaning?
section13.faq-answer4: It gets done here. The practice covers general and family dentistry through to dental implants, veneers and full-mouth reconstruction, so you are not sent across town mid-treatment. Most dental insurance is accepted, but not HMO or Medicaid.
